llamaServer.role: Optional MTP speculative-decoding engine. Installed only through the verified installer; launched by the backend when present, otherwise the built-in Metal engine is used.

notes: Assets and SHA-256 values are pinned from the official GitHub release metadata for b11342 (size cross-checked against the releases API; archive downloaded and hashed locally).
Runtime installation must still verify HTTPS origin, byte size, SHA-256, archive entries, and executable health before activation.
Day-to-day Mac inference uses the embedded llama-cpp-python Metal backend; this manifest covers the optional llama-server/llama-bench binaries.
